The design, the production, the maintenance and all additional required services related to these QKD Systems must be located in the European Union (EU-27) or in the European Economic Area (EEA). The Contracting Authority selects one (1) supplier for Quantum Key Delivery System and concludes a contract with the selected supplier. The contract period is two (2) years. The contract can be extended on an annual basis. The customer notifies the use of the option 3 months prior to the intended activation of the option. The contract period starts from the signing of the contract. Estimated starting time of the contract is October-November/2023. In addition to the Contract will be to drawn up a Non-Disclosure Agreement.
